_comment: Facts the owner has attested to directly, usually from having been in
the venue. These override every scraped source, because a person who
was there beats a database that was not.
This file exists because some things are true and unsourceable. Chinese
arcades in particular run imported and grey-market cabinets that no
official register lists: SEGA's WAHLAP register in mainland China
carries only maimai DX and CHUNITHM, so an ONGEKI cab there appears in
no official locator, and BemaniCN only has it if a user filed it.
Refusing to record what the owner saw, purely because the databases are
silent, would make the map less accurate rather than more honest.
Every entry says WHO vouched for it and WHEN, and the app renders that
provenance rather than passing it off as a source's claim. Keyed on the
venue's source page url, never on the arcade id - ids are reassigned on
every build.
Supported fields per venue:
add_games / remove_games - union or drop game slugs
exclude: true - drop the row from the map entirely (ghost stubs,
non-music venues whose source says no music games)
closed: true + closed_reason - keep the pin, mark permanently closed
evidence_url / note / attested_by / attested_at - provenance
To add one: append an entry with a key from links.ziv or links.bemanicn,
then run python -m scrapers.run_all --skip-scrape.
